examples.en: He has lived in this city since he graduated from university.
examples.cn: 自从大学毕业后，他就一直住在这座城市。

examples.en: Over the past few years, the company has made great progress in reducing waste.
examples.cn: 在过去的几年里，这家公司在减少废弃物方面取得了很大进展。

examples.en: It is the first time that scientists have successfully turned used plastic into high-quality building materials.
examples.cn: 这是科学家们首次成功将废旧塑料转化为高质量建筑材料。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework, so I can play now.
exercises.explain: 强调动作已完成且对现在有影响，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ never ______ to Beijing.
exercises.explain: never 常与现在完成时连用，主语 she 用 has。

exercises.q: ______ you ______ your keys yet?
exercises.explain: yet 用于现在完成时疑问句，表示“已经……了吗”。

exercises.q: He ______ just ______ the room.
exercises.explain: just 表示“刚刚”，与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: They ______ already ______ the movie.
exercises.explain: already 用于现在完成时肯定句，they 用 have。

exercises.q: I have ______ (eat) my lunch.
exercises.explain: have 后接过去分词 eaten。

exercises.q: She has ______ (write) a letter to her friend.
exercises.explain: write 的过去分词是 written。

exercises.q: We have ______ (see) that film before.
exercises.explain: see 的过去分词是 seen。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have visited the Great Wall last year." is correct.
exercises.explain: 有具体过去时间 last year 时不能用现在完成时，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.q: The sentence "She has already finished her work." is correct.
exercises.explain: already 与现在完成时连用，结构正确。

exercises.q: I have done my homework. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: I have not done my homework.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定在 have/has 后加 not。

exercises.q: She has finished her work. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时疑问句将 has 提前。

exercises.q: They have gone to the park. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: They have not gone to the park.
exercises.explain: 在 have 后加 not 构成否定。

exercises.q: He have finished his homework.
exercises.explain: 主语 he 是第三人称单数，应用 has。

exercises.q: I have saw that movie.
exercises.explain: see 的过去分词是 seen，不是 saw。

exercises.q: I ______ my keys. I can't find them anywhere.
exercises.explain: 强调过去丢失对现在造成影响（现在找不到），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ in this school since 2020.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语时主句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: ______ you ever ______ to Shanghai?
exercises.explain: ever 用于现在完成时疑问句，表示“曾经”。

exercises.q: He ______ not ______ his homework yet.
exercises.explain: yet 用于现在完成时否定句，主语 he 用 has。

exercises.q: We ______ each other for ten years.
exercises.explain: for + 时间段常与现在完成时连用，表示持续到现在的状态。

exercises.q: They have ______ (be) friends since primary school.
exercises.explain: be 的过去分词是 been，since 引导时间状语用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I have ______ (not finish) my project yet.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定形式为 have not + 过去分词。

exercises.q: She has ______ (make) great progress recently.
exercises.explain: make 的过去分词是 made，recently 常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: The sentence "He has gone to Beijing yesterday." is correct.
exercises.explain: 有 yesterday 这个具体过去时间，不能用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have known her for five years." is correct.
exercises.explain: for + 时间段与现在完成时连用表示持续状态，结构正确。

exercises.q: I have been to the Great Wall. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Have you been to the Great Wall?
exercises.explain: 现在完成时一般疑问句将 have 提前，人称相应变化。

exercises.q: She has already finished her homework. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: She has not finished her homework yet.
exercises.explain: 否定句中 already 通常改为 yet。

exercises.q: They have lived here for three years. (对 for three years 提问)
exercises.answer: How long have they lived here?
exercises.explain: 对时间段提问用 how long，后接现在完成时。

exercises.q: She has went to the library.
exercises.answer: She has gone to the library.
exercises.explain: go 的过去分词是 gone，不是 went。

exercises.q: I have finished my work two days ago.
exercises.answer: I finished my work two days ago.
exercises.explain: 有 ago 这个具体过去时间，应用一般过去时。

exercises.q: By the time we arrived, the meeting ______ already ______.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，主句动作发生在过去的过去，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: It is the first time that I ______ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explain: It is the first time that 从句中用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ in this company since she graduated from college.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时表示持续。

exercises.q: I ______ my phone. I can't remember where I put it.
exercises.explain: 强调过去动作对现在的影响（现在找不到），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He ______ to London three times this year.
exercises.explain: this year 表示到目前为止的时间段，常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: By the end of last month, they ______ (complete) the project.
exercises.explain: by the end of + 过去时间，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ (not hear) from her friend since she moved to another city.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语，主句用现在完成时否定。

exercises.q: This is the most interesting book I ______ ever ______ (read).
exercises.explain: 最高级 + ever 常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have been knowing him for ten years." is correct.
exercises.explain: know 是状态动词，通常不用进行时，应改为 have known。

exercises.q: The sentence "She has been to Paris twice." is correct.
exercises.explain: have been to 表示“去过某地”，结构正确。

exercises.q: I have never read such an interesting novel. (改为同义句)
exercises.answer: This is the most interesting novel I have ever read.
exercises.explain: never...such 可转换为最高级 + ever 结构。

exercises.q: She started working here five years ago. (用现在完成时改写)
exercises.answer: She has worked here for five years.
exercises.explain: 过去开始的动作持续到现在，用现在完成时 + for 时间段。

exercises.q: He has never been to Japan. (改为反意疑问句)
exercises.answer: He has never been to Japan, has he?
exercises.explain: 现在完成时反意疑问句，前否后肯，用 has he。

exercises.q: By the time he arrived, the train has already left.
exercises.answer: By the time he arrived, the train had already left.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，主句应用过去完成时。

exercises.q: I have bought this car for three years.
exercises.answer: I have had this car for three years.
exercises.explain: buy 是短暂性动词，不能与 for 时间段连用，应改为持续性动词 have。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework, so I can go out and play now.
exercises.explain: 强调过去完成的动作对现在造成的影响（可以出去玩了），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ never ______ to Beijing before.
exercises.explain: never 常与现在完成时连用，have/has been to 表示“去过某地”。

exercises.q: ______ you ______ your keys yet?
exercises.explain: yet 用于现在完成时的疑问句，表示“已经找到了吗”。

exercises.q: He ______ just ______ the classroom.
exercises.explain: just 表示“刚刚”，与现在完成时连用，主语 he 用 has。

exercises.q: They ______ in this city since 2018.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语时，主句常用现在完成时，表示从过去持续到现在的状态。

exercises.q: We ______ (already / see) that movie twice.
exercises.explain: already 用于现在完成时，表示“已经”，放在 have/has 和过去分词之间。

exercises.q: My brother ______ (not / finish) his lunch yet.
exercises.explain: yet 用于否定句，现在完成时否定形式为 have/has + not + 过去分词。

exercises.q: ______ she ever ______ (try) Japanese food?
exercises.explain: ever 用于现在完成时疑问句，主语 she 用 has，后接过去分词。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have seen him yesterday" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是明确的过去时间，不能与现在完成时连用，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.q: The sentence "She has lost her phone, so she can't call anyone" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时表示过去丢手机对现在造成影响（现在无法打电话），用法正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence into negative: I have done my homework.
exercises.answer: I have not done my homework.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定形式为 have/has + not + 过去分词。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence into a question: They have visited the museum.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时疑问句将 have/has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "just": He has finished his breakfast.
exercises.answer: He has just finished his breakfast.
exercises.explain: just 放在 have/has 和过去分词之间，表示“刚刚”。

exercises.q: She have already cleaned her room.
exercises.answer: She has already cleaned her room.
exercises.explain: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，现在完成时应用 has 而非 have。

exercises.q: I have saw that film before.
exercises.answer: I have seen that film before.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时中动词要用过去分词，see 的过去分词是 seen。

exercises.q: By the time we arrived at the station, the train ______.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，表示“过去的过去”用过去完成时。

exercises.q: This is the first time I ______ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explain: This/It is the first time 后接现在完成时，表示“第一次做某事”。

exercises.q: She ______ in the library for three hours and is still there.
exercises.explain: for three hours 且动作仍在继续，用现在完成进行时强调持续。

exercises.q: I ______ my keys. Can you help me look for them?
exercises.explain: 丢钥匙的动作发生在过去，但对现在有影响（现在找不到），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He ______ to London three times since 2020.
exercises.explain: since 2020 与现在完成时连用，has been to 表示“去过”，人已回来。

exercises.q: The children ______ (play) outside for two hours and they still don't want to come in.
exercises.explain: for two hours 且动作持续到现在，用现在完成进行时。

exercises.q: She ______ (not / hear) from her old friend since she moved to another city.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时，否定形式为 has not + 过去分词。

exercises.q: How long ______ you ______ (know) Mr. Wang?
exercises.explain: how long 询问持续时间，know 是延续性动词，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The sentence "He has gone to Shanghai, so he is not here now" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示“去了某地还没回来”，与“现在不在这里”逻辑一致。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have bought this book for two weeks" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: buy 是短暂性动词，不能与 for two weeks 连用，应改为 have had。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "already": She has finished her project.
exercises.answer: She has already finished her project.
exercises.explain: already 放在 have/has 和过去分词之间，表示“已经”。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence into a question: He has been working here since 2019.
exercises.answer: Has he been working here since 2019?
exercises.explain: 现在完成进行时疑问句将 has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "never": I have not seen such a funny movie.
exercises.answer: I have never seen such a funny movie.
exercises.explain: never 本身表否定，可替换 not，放在 have/has 和过去分词之间。

exercises.q: They have been to the park yesterday.
exercises.answer: They went to the park yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是明确的过去时间，不能用现在完成时，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.q: I have known him since five years.
exercises.answer: I have known him for five years.
exercises.explain: since 后接时间点，for 后接时间段，five years 是时间段，应用 for。

exercises.q: It is the most inspiring speech that I ______ in my entire life.
exercises.explain: It is + 最高级 + that 从句中常用现在完成时，ever 加强语气。

exercises.q: By the end of last month, they ______ more than 5,000 trees in the area.
exercises.explain: by the end of last month 表示“到上个月末为止”，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: The products that ______ can be recycled into new materials.
exercises.explain: products 与 use 是被动关系，且强调已完成的状态，用现在完成时的被动语态。

exercises.q: No sooner ______ the door than the phone rang.
exercises.explain: no sooner...than 句型中，no sooner 置于句首时主句部分倒装，且用过去完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ on this research project for over a decade, and the results are finally showing.
exercises.explain: for over a decade 且动作持续到现在并仍在进行，用现在完成进行时。

exercises.q: Hardly ______ he ______ (enter) the room when the lights went out.
exercises.explain: hardly...when 句型中，hardly 置于句首时主句部分倒装，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: The old factory ______ (transform) into a modern art center over the past few years.
exercises.explain: over the past few years 与现在完成时连用，factory 与 transform 是被动关系。

exercises.q: It is high time that we ______ (take) effective measures to protect the environment.
exercises.explain: It is high time that 句型中从句用一般过去时或 should + 动词原形，表虚拟语气。

exercises.q: The sentence "Having finished his homework, he went out to play basketball" contains a present perfect tense.
exercises.explain: Having finished 是现在分词的完成式作状语，不是现在完成时谓语。

exercises.q: The sentence "She has been to the United States twice, and she is planning a third trip" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: has been to 表示“去过某地已回来”，与后文计划第三次旅行逻辑一致。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using inversion: I had no sooner arrived home than it began to rain.
exercises.answer: No sooner had I arrived home than it began to rain.
exercises.explain: no sooner 置于句首时，主句用部分倒装，将 had 提到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence into passive voice: They have already used these products.
exercises.answer: These products have already been used.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时被动语态结构为 have/has + been + 过去分词。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "since": I last saw her five years ago.
exercises.answer: I have not seen her since five years ago.
exercises.explain: since + 过去时间点与现在完成时连用，表示从那时起到现在。

exercises.q: The committee has been discussing the proposal for three hours before they finally reached an agreement.
exercises.answer: The committee had been discussing the proposal for three hours before they finally reached an agreement.
exercises.explain: before 从句用一般过去时，主句表示“过去的过去”持续的动作，应用过去完成进行时。

exercises.q: It is the second time that he made the same mistake.
exercises.answer: It is the second time that he has made the same mistake.
exercises.explain: It is the + 序数词 + time 后接 that 从句，从句用现在完成时。

grammar.title: 定语从句（which）——从指物到指代整句，兼谈非限制性定语从句
grammar.titleEn: Relative Clause (which): Referring to Things and Whole Clauses
grammar.usage:
定语从句用于修饰名词或代词，which 是关系代词，主要用于指代事物、动物，也可指代前面整个主句的内容。其核心结构为“先行词 + which + 从句”，which 在从句中可作主语、宾语或表语。肯定句中，which 直接引导从句；否定句在从句内部使用 not、never 等否定词；疑问句则体现在主句的疑问形式上，which 从句本身不改变语序。

在初中阶段，which 主要用来指代单个表示事物的名词，例如 the book which I bought。高中阶段则重点掌握 which 指代整个主句的用法，此时 which 前必须有逗号，构成非限制性定语从句，常译为“这/这件事”，表示主句行为带来的结果、评价或补充说明。

与 that 相比，which 更常用于非限制性定语从句和介词后（如 in which, for which），而 that 不能用于非限制性定语从句，也不能直接放在介词后。与 as 相比，as 引导非限制性定语从句时常表示“正如”，可置于句首、句中或句末，而 which 只能置于主句之后，且多表示客观结果而非主观推断。

易错点一：which 指代整句时，谓语动词用单数，因为整个主句被视为一个整体概念。易错点二：非限制性定语从句中不能使用 that，只能用 which。易错点三：which 指代整句时不能放在句首，只能位于主句之后。易错点四：当先行词被 all、the only、the very、序数词或最高级修饰时，关系代词通常用 that 而不用 which。
forms: 先行词（事物）+ which + 从句（which 作主语）
先行词（事物）+ which + 主语 + 谓语（which 作宾语）
介词 + which + 从句（如 in which, for which）
主句, which + 从句（which 指代整个主句，谓语用单数）
主句, 介词 + which + 从句（非限制性定语从句中介词前置）
notes: which 指代整个主句时，从句谓语动词必须用单数形式，因为整个主句被视为一个整体概念。
非限制性定语从句中只能用 which，不能用 that；高考书面语中混淆两者属于典型错误。
which 指代整句时只能放在主句之后，不能置于句首；若需置于句首表示“正如”，应改用 as。
在高考语篇填空和短文改错中，注意区分 which 与 where、when：which 指代事物或整句，where 指代地点，when 指代时间。
书面语中，介词 + which 的结构比介词后置更正式，如 the way in which 比 the way which...in 更符合正式语域。

examples.en: I found the key which was lost yesterday.
examples.cn: 我找到了昨天丢失的那把钥匙。

examples.en: The movie which we saw last night was really exciting.
examples.cn: 我们昨晚看的那部电影真的很刺激。

examples.en: She bought a new phone, which cost her a lot of money.
examples.cn: 她买了一部新手机，这花了她很多钱。

examples.en: The city has improved public transportation, which makes commuting much easier.
examples.cn: 这座城市改善了公共交通，这使得通勤变得容易多了。

examples.en: He failed to meet the deadline, for which he apologized to the whole team.
examples.cn: 他未能按时完成任务，为此他向整个团队道了歉。

examples.en: The committee adopted a new policy, the long-term effects of which remain to be seen.
examples.cn: 委员会通过了一项新政策，其长期效果还有待观察。

exercises.q: I have a new bike, ______ is very fast.
exercises.explain: which 指代事物（bike），引导定语从句。

exercises.q: The book ______ is on the desk is mine.
exercises.explain: which 指代 the book，在从句中作主语。

exercises.q: She has a cat ______ likes sleeping all day.
exercises.explain: which 可以指代动物（cat）。

exercises.q: This is the movie ______ we watched last night.
exercises.explain: which 指代 the movie，在从句中作宾语。

exercises.q: The apples ______ are in the bag are red.
exercises.explain: which 指代 the apples，表示事物。

exercises.q: The pen ______ is on the table is blue.
exercises.explain: which 引导定语从句修饰 the pen。

exercises.q: I like the toy ______ my father gave me.
exercises.explain: which 在从句中作 gave 的宾语。

exercises.q: The dog ______ is running in the park is very cute.
exercises.explain: which 指代动物 dog。

exercises.q: The car which is red belongs to my uncle.
exercises.explain: which 正确引导定语从句修饰 the car。

exercises.q: The girl which is singing is my sister.
exercises.explain: 指人时应用 who，不用 which。

exercises.q: I have a bag. The bag is black. (用 which 合并句子)
exercises.answer: I have a bag which is black.
exercises.explain: 用 which 连接两个句子，修饰 the bag。

exercises.q: The house is big. We live in the house. (用 which 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The house which we live in is big.
exercises.explain: which 引导定语从句，介词 in 可放在从句末尾。

exercises.q: This is a bird. The bird can sing. (用 which 合并句子)
exercises.answer: This is a bird which can sing.
exercises.explain: which 指代动物 bird，引导定语从句。

exercises.q: The cake who is on the plate is delicious.
exercises.answer: The cake which is on the plate is delicious.
exercises.explain: cake 是事物，应用 which 而非 who。

exercises.q: I have a phone which it is very expensive.
exercises.answer: I have a phone which is very expensive.
exercises.explain: which 已作主语，不能再加 it。

exercises.q: He passed the exam, ______ made his parents very happy.
exercises.explain: which 指代前面整个句子，表示结果。

exercises.q: The city ______ I was born is very beautiful.
exercises.explain: where 在定语从句中作地点状语，表示出生地。

exercises.q: She told me a story, ______ I couldn't believe.
exercises.explain: which 指代 a story，在从句中作 believe 的宾语。

exercises.q: The film ______ we saw yesterday was boring.
exercises.explain: which 指代 the film，在从句中作宾语。

exercises.q: He lost his keys, ______ was a big problem.
exercises.explain: which 指代前面整个事件，表示结果。

exercises.q: The school ______ I study is very old.
exercises.explain: where 在定语从句中作地点状语。

exercises.q: She bought a dress, ______ cost her a lot of money.
exercises.explain: which 指代 a dress，在非限制性定语从句中作主语。

exercises.q: The reason ______ he was late is not clear.
exercises.explain: why 引导定语从句修饰 the reason。

exercises.q: The book which cover is red is mine.
exercises.explain: 表示所属关系应用 whose，而非 which。

exercises.q: He didn't come, which made me angry.
exercises.explain: which 正确指代前面整个句子。

exercises.q: The house is very old. We live in the house. (用 where 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The house where we live is very old.
exercises.explain: where 在定语从句中作地点状语。

exercises.q: She was late for class. This made the teacher angry. (用 which 合并句子)
exercises.answer: She was late for class, which made the teacher angry.
exercises.explain: which 指代前面整个事件，引导非限制性定语从句。

exercises.q: The man is my uncle. You met the man yesterday. (用 whom 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The man whom you met yesterday is my uncle.
exercises.explain: whom 在定语从句中作 met 的宾语，指人。

exercises.q: The city which I was born is very big.
exercises.answer: The city where I was born is very big.
exercises.explain: 表示地点应用 where，而非 which。

exercises.q: She has a friend which can speak three languages.
exercises.answer: She has a friend who can speak three languages.
exercises.explain: 指人时应用 who，而非 which。

exercises.q: The company has developed a new recycling system, ______ greatly reduces waste.
exercises.explain: which 指代 a new recycling system，在非限制性定语从句中作主语。

exercises.q: He made several mistakes in the report, ______ was unacceptable.
exercises.explain: which 指代前面整个事件，表示结果。

exercises.q: The museum ______ we visited last week has a large collection of ancient art.
exercises.explain: which 在从句中作 visited 的宾语。

exercises.q: The project, ______ was started last year, has been very successful.
exercises.explain: 非限制性定语从句中只能用 which，不能用 that。

exercises.q: She gave me a book ______ cover was torn.
exercises.explain: whose 表示所属关系，修饰 cover。

exercises.q: The factory ______ produces these products is located in the north.
exercises.explain: which 指代 the factory，在从句中作主语。

exercises.q: He failed the test, ______ surprised everyone.
exercises.explain: which 指代前面整个事件，引导非限制性定语从句。

exercises.q: The house ______ windows are broken is being repaired.
exercises.explain: whose 表示所属关系，修饰 windows。

exercises.q: The new policy, which was introduced last month, has been widely accepted.
exercises.explain: which 正确引导非限制性定语从句，补充说明政策。

exercises.q: He is the only person which can solve this problem.
exercises.explain: 指人时应用 who 或 that，不用 which。

exercises.q: The team won the championship. This was a great achievement. (用 which 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The team won the championship, which was a great achievement.
exercises.explain: which 指代前面整个事件，引导非限制性定语从句。

exercises.q: The book is on the shelf. Its cover is blue. (用 whose 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The book whose cover is blue is on the shelf.
exercises.explain: whose 表示所属关系，连接两个句子。

exercises.q: She has a car. The car can run very fast. (用 which 合并句子)
exercises.answer: She has a car which can run very fast.
exercises.explain: which 指代 the car，引导定语从句。

exercises.q: The report which he wrote it was very detailed.
exercises.answer: The report which he wrote was very detailed.
exercises.explain: which 已作宾语，不能再加 it。

exercises.q: The company, that was founded in 1990, has grown rapidly.
exercises.answer: The company, which was founded in 1990, has grown rapidly.
exercises.explain: 非限制性定语从句中不能用 that，应用 which。

exercises.q: The movie ______ we watched last night was really exciting.
exercises.explain: 先行词是物（movie），关系代词用 which。

exercises.q: I lost the book ______ my father gave me on my birthday.
exercises.explain: 先行词是物（book），关系代词 which 在从句中作宾语。

exercises.q: The dog ______ is running in the garden belongs to my neighbor.
exercises.explain: 先行词是动物（dog），关系代词用 which。

exercises.q: She showed me a photo ______ was taken in Paris.
exercises.explain: 先行词是物（photo），which 在从句中作主语。

exercises.q: The computer ______ I bought yesterday works very well.
exercises.explain: 先行词是物（computer），which 在从句中作宾语。

exercises.q: The song ______ she is singing is very beautiful.
exercises.explain: 先行词是物（song），用 which 引导定语从句。

exercises.q: I have a new phone ______ takes great pictures.
exercises.explain: 先行词是物（phone），which 在从句中作主语。

exercises.q: The cake ______ my mother made was delicious.
exercises.explain: 先行词是物（cake），which 在从句中作宾语。

exercises.q: The car which is parked outside is mine.
exercises.explain: which 指代物（car），从句修饰 car，句子正确。

exercises.q: The teacher which teaches us English is very kind.
exercises.explain: 先行词是人（teacher），应该用 who 而不是 which。

exercises.q: I have a cat. The cat is very cute. (用 which 合并成一句)
exercises.answer: I have a cat which is very cute.
exercises.explain: 用 which 指代 cat，将两个句子合并为定语从句。

exercises.q: She bought a dress. The dress was made in China. (用 which 合并成一句)
exercises.answer: She bought a dress which was made in China.
exercises.explain: 用 which 指代 dress，合并为定语从句。

exercises.q: The movie was interesting. We saw the movie last week. (用 which 合并成一句)
exercises.answer: The movie which we saw last week was interesting.
exercises.explain: which 在从句中作宾语，指代 the movie。

exercises.q: The book who is on the table is mine.
exercises.answer: The book which is on the table is mine.
exercises.explain: 先行词是物（book），关系代词应该用 which 而不是 who。

exercises.q: I like the gift which you gave it to me.
exercises.answer: I like the gift which you gave to me.
exercises.explain: which 在从句中已经作宾语，不能再加 it。

exercises.q: He missed the bus, ______ made him late for school.
exercises.explain: which 指代前面整个主句，表示结果，前面用逗号。

exercises.q: The house ______ roof is red belongs to my uncle.
exercises.explain: roof 与 house 是所属关系，用 whose 表示“房子的屋顶”。

exercises.q: This is the factory ______ my father used to work.
exercises.explain: 先行词是地点（factory），从句中缺少地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: The reason ______ he was late was that he got up late.
exercises.explain: 先行词是 reason，从句中缺少原因状语，用 why。

exercises.q: She told me everything ______ she knew about the accident.
exercises.explain: 先行词是 everything，不定代词后常用 that 引导定语从句。

exercises.q: The team won the game, ______ surprised everyone.
exercises.explain: which 指代前面整个主句，表示令人惊讶的结果。

exercises.q: This is the room in ______ we had the meeting.
exercises.explain: 介词 in 后接 which，指代 room，表示地点。

exercises.q: The film ______ we are talking about is very popular.
exercises.explain: 先行词是物（film），which 在从句中作介词 about 的宾语。

exercises.q: He passed the exam, which made his parents very happy.
exercises.explain: which 指代前面整个主句，表示结果，句子正确。

exercises.q: The city which I was born is very beautiful.
exercises.explain: 先行词是地点（city），从句中缺少地点状语，应该用 where 或 in which。

exercises.q: He didn't come to the party. This made me angry. (用 which 合并成一句)
exercises.answer: He didn't come to the party, which made me angry.
exercises.explain: which 指代前面整个主句，表示结果。

exercises.q: The house is very old. We live in the house. (用 in which 合并成一句)
exercises.answer: The house in which we live is very old.
exercises.explain: in which 相当于 where，指代地点。

exercises.q: She has a friend. The friend's father is a doctor. (用 whose 合并成一句)
exercises.answer: She has a friend whose father is a doctor.
exercises.explain: whose 表示所属关系，指代 friend's。

exercises.q: The news which he told me were very surprising.
exercises.answer: The news which he told me was very surprising.
exercises.explain: news 是不可数名词，谓语动词应该用 was。

exercises.q: This is the museum which we visited it last year.
exercises.answer: This is the museum which we visited last year.
exercises.explain: which 在从句中已经作宾语，不能再加 it。

exercises.q: The company has developed a new recycling system, ______ significantly reduces the amount of waste.
exercises.explain: which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面的 system，前面用逗号。

exercises.q: There are many factors ______ contribute to climate change, among which carbon emissions are the most significant.
exercises.explain: which 指代 factors，在从句中作主语，引导定语从句。

exercises.q: The professor introduced a new theory, the significance of ______ was not fully understood at that time.
exercises.explain: 介词 of 后接 which，指代 theory，构成非限制性定语从句。

exercises.q: He made a careless mistake, ______ cost him the opportunity to win the competition.
exercises.explain: which 指代前面整个主句，表示结果，前面用逗号。

exercises.q: The experiment, ______ results were published last week, has attracted wide attention.
exercises.explain: whose 表示所属关系，指代 experiment's results。

exercises.q: The government has launched a campaign ______ aims to raise public awareness of environmental protection.
exercises.explain: which 指代 campaign，在从句中作主语。

exercises.q: He failed to meet the deadline, ______ resulted in the cancellation of the project.
exercises.explain: which 指代前面整个主句，表示结果。

exercises.q: The report contains several recommendations, none of ______ has been implemented yet.
exercises.explain: 介词 of 后接 which，指代 recommendations。

exercises.q: The new policy, which was introduced last month, has already shown positive effects.
exercises.explain: which 引导非限制性定语从句，补充说明 policy，句子正确。

exercises.q: The data which was collected from the survey is being analyzed by the research team.
exercises.explain: data 在此处视为不可数名词，谓语用 is，which 指代 data，句子正确。

exercises.q: The company recycled thousands of tons of waste. This greatly reduced its carbon footprint. (用 which 合并成一句)
exercises.answer: The company recycled thousands of tons of waste, which greatly reduced its carbon footprint.
exercises.explain: which 指代前面整个主句，表示结果。

exercises.q: The scientist proposed a hypothesis. The validity of the hypothesis was later confirmed. (用 the validity of which 合并成一句)
exercises.answer: The scientist proposed a hypothesis, the validity of which was later confirmed.
exercises.explain: the validity of which 表示“该假设的有效性”，构成非限制性定语从句。

exercises.q: They adopted a new approach. The approach proved to be highly effective. (用 which 合并成一句)
exercises.answer: They adopted a new approach which proved to be highly effective.
exercises.explain: which 指代 approach，在从句中作主语。

exercises.q: The committee has put forward a proposal which it aims to solve the traffic problem.
exercises.answer: The committee has put forward a proposal which aims to solve the traffic problem.
exercises.explain: which 在从句中作主语，不需要再加 it。

exercises.q: The research findings, that were published in a leading journal, have been widely cited.
exercises.answer: The research findings, which were published in a leading journal, have been widely cited.
exercises.explain: 非限制性定语从句不能用 that，只能用 which。

grammar.key: Comparative Form (more and more) / 比较级 (more and more)
grammar.title: 比较级递进结构（more and more / 越来越……）及其拓展：含 -er and -er、less and less、increasingly 等
grammar.titleEn: Comparative Progression: more and more, -er and -er, less and less, and Related Structures
grammar.usage:
本语法点的核心结构是用“比较级 + and + 比较级”或“more and more + 名词/形容词/副词”来表示某种性质、数量或程度在持续增加或逐渐变化，中文常译为“越来越……”。其基本形式分为两类：一类是单音节或部分双音节形容词/副词，直接重复比较级，如 bigger and bigger, faster and faster, colder and colder；另一类是多音节形容词/副词，用 more and more 加原级，如 more and more beautiful, more and more carefully。此外，more and more 后面还可以直接接不可数名词或复数名词，表示数量上的持续增多，如 more and more people, more and more pollution。

肯定句结构为“主语 + 谓语 + 比较级 + and + 比较级”或“主语 + 谓语 + more and more + 形容词/副词/名词”。否定句通常在谓语部分进行否定，如“The situation is not getting better and better.”，但要注意这种否定往往带有“并非越来越……”的含义，而不是“越来越不……”。疑问句则将助动词或 be 动词提前，如“Is the problem becoming more and more serious?”。

与近义结构对比时需要注意：more and more 强调“持续增加”的动态过程，而 increasingly 是副词，常用于书面语，修饰形容词或动词，如 increasingly important，语气更正式。less and less 则表示“越来越少/越来越不”，是 more and more 的反义结构，如 less and less interested。此外，比较级递进结构不同于普通的比较级句型“A is more ... than B”，后者是两者之间的比较，而前者是同一事物自身在不同时间或阶段的变化。

初中阶段主要要求学生掌握“比较级 + and + 比较级”和“more and more + 形容词”的基本用法，能够翻译“越来越……”的句子，常见于天气、人物变化等话题。高中阶段则进一步拓展到 more and more + 名词、less and less、increasingly 等书面表达形式，并要求在议论文、说明文和读后续写中灵活运用，以增强语言的表现力和逻辑层次。

易错点一：部分双音节形容词的比较级形式容易混淆，如 friendly 的比较级是 friendlier，而不是 more friendly，因此“越来越友好”应写为 friendlier and friendlier。易错点二：more and more 后面接名词时，名词的数要根据语境判断，不可数名词用单数，可数名词常用复数，如 more and more information 和 more and more students。易错点三：不要把“越来越不……”直接写成“more and more not ...”，应使用 less and less 或 not ... any more 等结构。易错点四：在书面表达中，避免过度重复使用 more and more，可适当用 increasingly、growing numbers of 等替换，以提升语域和词汇多样性。
forms: 单音节形容词/副词：比较级 + and + 比较级（如 bigger and bigger, faster and faster）
多音节形容词/副词：more and more + 原级（如 more and more beautiful, more and more carefully）
more and more + 不可数名词/复数名词（如 more and more pollution, more and more countries）
反义结构：less and less + 形容词/副词/名词（如 less and less important, less and less time）
书面语替换：increasingly + 形容词/副词（如 increasingly serious, increasingly common）
否定句：主语 + be/助动词 + not + 比较级 + and + 比较级（如 is not getting better and better）
notes: 高考书面表达中，more and more 使用频率很高，但连续多次出现会显得词汇单一，建议在议论文中适当替换为 increasingly、a growing number of 等表达。
注意 less and less 后面接不可数名词或形容词，表示“越来越少/越来越不”，不要与 fewer and fewer 混淆：fewer and fewer 用于可数名词复数，如 fewer and fewer mistakes。
部分双音节形容词比较级有两种形式时，如 simple 可写 simpler 或 more simple，但在“越来越……”结构中，习惯上优先使用 -er 形式，如 simpler and simpler。
在正式书面语中，more and more 修饰名词时，要注意名词的可数性，避免出现 more and more student 这样的错误，应写为 more and more students。
比较级递进结构通常描述同一事物的渐变过程，不要将其用于两者之间的对比，两者对比应使用 than 结构，如 A is bigger than B。

examples.en: The weather is getting colder and colder.
examples.cn: 天气变得越来越冷。

examples.en: My little brother is growing taller and taller every year.
examples.cn: 我的弟弟每年都在长得越来越高。

examples.en: More and more students are interested in learning English.
examples.cn: 越来越多的学生对学习英语感兴趣。

examples.en: As the exam approaches, she is becoming more and more nervous.
examples.cn: 随着考试临近，她变得越来越紧张。

examples.en: With the development of technology, people are relying less and less on cash.
examples.cn: 随着科技的发展，人们对现金的依赖越来越少。

examples.en: In modern society, effective communication skills are becoming increasingly important in the workplace.
examples.cn: 在现代社会，有效的沟通技巧在职场中正变得越来越重要。

exercises.q: The weather is getting ______.
exercises.explain: 短形容词 hot 的比较级要双写 t 再加 er，用“比较级+and+比较级”表示越来越热。

exercises.q: ______ students are learning English in China now.
exercises.explain: “more and more + 名词”表示数量持续增加，意为“越来越多的”。

exercises.q: My little sister is growing ______.
exercises.explain: 短形容词 tall 用“比较级+and+比较级”表示“越来越高”。

exercises.q: The city is becoming ______ beautiful.
exercises.explain: 长形容词 beautiful 前用 more and more 表示“越来越美丽”。

exercises.q: In spring, the days get ______.
exercises.explain: 短形容词 long 用“比较级+and+比较级”表示“越来越长”。

exercises.q: The baby is crying ______ and ______ (loud).
exercises.explain: 短形容词 loud 用比较级重复结构表示“越来越大声”。

exercises.q: There are ______ and ______ cars on the road.
exercises.explain: “more and more + 复数名词”表示“越来越多的汽车”。

exercises.q: The story becomes ______ and ______ interesting.
exercises.explain: 长形容词 interesting 前用 more and more 表示“越来越有趣”。

exercises.q: The sentence "It is getting colder and colder" means the temperature is going down slowly.
exercises.explain: colder and colder 表示“越来越冷”，即温度在逐渐下降。

exercises.q: We can say "more and more tall" to mean someone is growing taller.
exercises.explain: tall 是短形容词，应用 taller and taller，不能用 more and more tall。

exercises.q: The city is getting bigger. (用 more and more 改写，保持意思相近)
exercises.answer: The city is getting bigger and bigger.
exercises.explain: 用“比较级+and+比较级”结构表达持续增长的变化。

exercises.q: More and more people like riding bikes. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: More and more people don't like riding bikes.
exercises.explain: 一般现在时否定句在动词前加 don't，more and more 结构保持不变。

exercises.q: The music is becoming louder and louder. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Is the music becoming louder and louder?
exercises.explain: 现在进行时变一般疑问句将 be 动词提前，比较级结构不变。

exercises.q: The tree is growing more and more tall.
exercises.answer: The tree is growing taller and taller.
exercises.explain: tall 是短形容词，应用 taller and taller 而不是 more and more tall。

exercises.q: There are many and many books in the library.
exercises.answer: There are more and more books in the library.
exercises.explain: 表示“越来越多的”应用 more and more，而不是 many and many。

exercises.q: As winter comes, the nights get ______.
exercises.explain: 短形容词 long 用比较级重复结构表示“越来越长”。

exercises.q: ______ people are choosing to work from home.
exercises.explain: “more and more + 名词”表示数量持续增加。

exercises.q: The problem is becoming ______ difficult to solve.
exercises.explain: 长形容词 difficult 前用 more and more 表示“越来越困难”。

exercises.q: The little boy is running ______.
exercises.explain: 短副词 fast 用比较级重复结构表示“越来越快”。

exercises.q: The air in the city is getting ______.
exercises.explain: bad 的比较级是不规则形式 worse，用 worse and worse 表示“越来越糟”。

exercises.q: The students are becoming ______ and ______ interested in science.
exercises.explain: 长形容词 interested 前用 more and more 表示“越来越感兴趣”。

exercises.q: As the exam gets closer, he studies ______ and ______ (hard).
exercises.explain: 短副词 hard 用比较级重复结构表示“越来越努力”。

exercises.q: ______ and ______ countries are paying attention to environmental protection.
exercises.explain: “more and more + 复数名词”表示“越来越多的国家”。

exercises.q: The phrase "better and better" means something is improving continuously.
exercises.explain: better and better 表示“越来越好”，即持续改善。

exercises.q: We can say "more and more better" to emphasize improvement.
exercises.explain: better 已经是比较级，不能再用 more，应直接用 better and better。

exercises.q: The traffic is becoming heavier. (用比较级重复结构改写)
exercises.answer: The traffic is becoming heavier and heavier.
exercises.explain: heavy 的比较级是 heavier，用“比较级+and+比较级”表示持续加重。

exercises.q: More and more students are joining the club. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Are more and more students joining the club?
exercises.explain: 现在进行时变疑问句将 be 动词提前，more and more 结构不变。

exercises.q: The weather is getting colder and colder. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: The weather is not getting colder and colder.
exercises.explain: 现在进行时否定句在 be 动词后加 not，比较级结构不变。

exercises.q: The situation is becoming more and more worse.
exercises.answer: The situation is becoming worse and worse.
exercises.explain: worse 已经是比较级，不能与 more 连用，应直接用 worse and worse。

exercises.q: She is becoming more and more good at English.
exercises.answer: She is becoming better and better at English.
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是不规则形式 better，应用 better and better。

exercises.q: With the development of technology, ______ people are using smartphones to pay for things.
exercises.explain: “more and more + 名词”表示数量持续增加，符合语境。

exercises.q: As the global temperature rises, the weather patterns are becoming ______ unpredictable.
exercises.explain: 长形容词 unpredictable 前用 more and more 表示“越来越难以预测”。

exercises.q: The gap between the rich and the poor is getting ______ in some areas.
exercises.explain: 短形容词 wide 用比较级重复结构表示“越来越大”。

exercises.q: He found that his interest in the subject was growing ______ as he studied deeper.
exercises.explain: 短形容词 strong 用比较级重复结构表示“越来越强烈”。

exercises.q: ______ countries are realizing the importance of sustainable development.
exercises.explain: “more and more + 复数名词”表示“越来越多的国家”。

exercises.q: As the competition intensifies, the players are training ______ and ______ (hard).
exercises.explain: 短副词 hard 用比较级重复结构表示“越来越努力”。

exercises.q: The influence of social media on young people is becoming ______ and ______ significant.
exercises.explain: 长形容词 significant 前用 more and more 表示“越来越重要”。

exercises.q: As the city expands, the demand for public transportation is growing ______ and ______ (large).
exercises.explain: 短形容词 large 用比较级重复结构表示“越来越大”。

exercises.q: The structure "more and more + noun" can only be used with countable nouns.
exercises.explain: more and more 既可以修饰可数名词复数，也可以修饰不可数名词，如 more and more water。

exercises.q: In the sentence "The situation is getting more and more complex", "complex" is a long adjective.
exercises.explain: complex 是多音节形容词，属于长形容词，用 more and more 修饰。

exercises.q: The number of people who prefer online shopping is increasing continuously. (用 more and more 改写)
exercises.answer: More and more people prefer online shopping.
exercises.explain: 用“more and more + 名词”结构替代“is increasing continuously”表达持续增长。

exercises.q: The environmental problems are becoming increasingly serious. (用比较级重复结构改写)
exercises.answer: The environmental problems are becoming more and more serious.
exercises.explain: 长形容词 serious 用 more and more 结构替代 increasingly 表达“越来越严重”。

exercises.q: As time goes by, he misses his hometown more. (用比较级重复结构改写)
exercises.answer: As time goes by, he misses his hometown more and more.
exercises.explain: 用“more and more”修饰动词 miss，表示程度持续加深。

exercises.q: The company is becoming more and more stronger in the international market.
exercises.answer: The company is becoming stronger and stronger in the international market.
exercises.explain: stronger 已经是比较级，不能与 more 连用，应直接用 stronger and stronger。

exercises.q: More and more evidences show that climate change is a serious threat.
exercises.answer: More and more evidence shows that climate change is a serious threat.
exercises.explain: evidence 是不可数名词，不能用复数形式，且谓语动词应用 shows。

exercises.q: As cities grow, ______ people are moving into new apartment buildings.
exercises.explain: 考查 more and more + 名词表示数量持续增加。

exercises.q: The weather is getting ______. We should wear warm clothes.
exercises.explain: 考查单音节形容词比较级重复表示“越来越冷”。

exercises.q: My little sister is growing ______ every year.
exercises.explain: 考查单音节形容词比较级重复表示持续变化。

exercises.q: With practice, her English is becoming ______.
exercises.explain: 考查不规则比较级 better 的重复结构。

exercises.q: ______ students are choosing to study online these days.
exercises.explain: 考查 more and more + 可数名词复数表示数量增加。

exercises.q: The city is becoming ______ and ______ crowded because of the new subway lines.
exercises.explain: 考查多音节形容词 crowded 用 more and more 表示越来越拥挤。

exercises.q: As winter comes, the days get ______ and ______.
exercises.explain: 考查单音节形容词比较级重复表示“越来越短”。

exercises.q: ______ and ______ people are using smartphones to pay for things.
exercises.explain: 考查 more and more + 名词表示数量持续增加。

exercises.q: The sentence "The river is getting cleaner and cleaner" means the river is becoming dirtier.
exercises.explain: cleaner and cleaner 表示越来越干净，而不是越来越脏。

exercises.q: In the structure "more and more + noun", the noun can be countable or uncountable.
exercises.explain: more and more 后可接可数名词复数或不可数名词。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "more and more": There are many cars on the road, and the number is increasing.
exercises.answer: There are more and more cars on the road.
exercises.explain: 考查用 more and more + 名词表达数量持续增加。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using the "comparative + and + comparative" pattern: The music is becoming loud.
exercises.answer: The music is becoming louder and louder.
exercises.explain: 考查单音节形容词比较级重复表示程度持续增加。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "more and more": People are using electric cars. The number is growing.
exercises.answer: More and more people are using electric cars.
exercises.explain: 考查用 more and more + 名词表达人数持续增加。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The problem is getting more and more big.
exercises.answer: The problem is getting bigger and bigger.
exercises.explain: 单音节形容词 big 应用 bigger and bigger，而非 more and more big。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: More and more student are joining the science club.
exercises.answer: More and more students are joining the science club.

grammar.key: Passive Voice (Present Simple) / 被动语态 (一般现在时)
grammar.title: 一般现在时被动语态：从“被”字句到高中语域运用
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice (Present Simple): From Basic 'Be + V3' to Academic and Written Registers
grammar.usage:
一般现在时被动语态的核心结构是“主语 + am/is/are + 过去分词（V3）”。它把关注点从“谁做”转移到“发生了什么”或“承受者是谁”。当动作的执行者未知、不重要、显而易见，或说话人有意弱化执行者时，使用被动语态。肯定句如：The waste is separated before recycling. 否定句在 be 后加 not：These bottles are not thrown away. 一般疑问句把 be 提到主语前：Is the rubbish collected daily? 特殊疑问句则用“疑问词 + be + 主语 + V3”：Where is the waste sent?

与近义结构对比：主动语态强调执行者（Workers collect the rubbish every day.），而被动语态强调承受者或结果（The rubbish is collected every day.）。在一般现在时中，被动语态常与“一般现在时主动语态”形成视角差异。此外，高中阶段还需区分“一般现在时被动”与“情态动词被动”（如 should be done）以及“现在进行时被动”（如 is being done），前者表示常态、规律或客观事实，后两者分别表示义务/建议和正在进行的动作。

初中用法主要停留在“be + V3”的基本转换，如“People speak English.”变为“English is spoken.”，侧重机械操练和单复数一致。高中用法则进一步要求：在说明文、科普文、新闻报道、学术写作等正式语域中主动使用被动语态，使表达客观、正式；同时能识别并运用“by + 执行者”的取舍原则，以及“get + V3”在口语中的非正式被动含义。

易错点：第一，主语与 be 动词的单复数不一致，如“The products is made”是典型错误；第二，过去分词形式写错，尤其是不规则动词，如 put 的过去分词仍是 put，不是 putted；第三，把不及物动词误用于被动语态，如 happen、appear、die 等不能构成被动；第四，在不需要指出执行者时滥用 by 短语，使句子累赘且不符合英语表达习惯。
forms: 肯定式：主语 + am/is/are + 过去分词（V3）
否定式：主语 + am/is/are + not + 过去分词（V3）
一般疑问式：Am/Is/Are + 主语 + 过去分词（V3）？
特殊疑问式：疑问词 + am/is/are + 主语 + 过去分词（V3）？
带执行者：主语 + am/is/are + 过去分词 + by + 执行者
情态动词被动（拓展）：主语 + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词（V3）
notes: 高考书面表达中，说明文和议论文常用一般现在时被动语态来增强客观性，如“Measures are taken to reduce pollution.”比“People take measures...”更正式。
注意不规则动词的过去分词拼写：put→put，cut→cut，read→read，但 write→written，break→broken，在被动语态中尤其容易出错。
不及物动词不能用于被动语态，如 happen、appear、exist、remain、belong to 等，不能说“The accident is happened.”。
在高中语域中，当执行者不言自明或无需强调时，不要画蛇添足加 by 短语。例如“English is widely used.”比“English is widely used by people.”更自然。
口语或非正式文体中，get + V3 可表达被动含义，如“The glass gets broken easily.”，但高考书面表达中建议优先使用 be + V3，以保持正式语域。

grammar.key: Present Simple Tense for General Truths / 一般现在时表示普遍真理
grammar.title: 一般现在时表示普遍真理（拓展：与一般过去时/一般将来时/客观事实表达对比）
grammar.titleEn: Present Simple Tense for General Truths (Extended: vs. Past/Future Tenses & Factual Expressions)
grammar.usage:
一般现在时用于表示普遍真理、客观事实、自然规律、科学结论以及长期存在的状态。这类内容不随说话时间改变，因此谓语动词使用一般现在时，即使主句或上下文是过去时或将来时，从句中描述真理的部分仍用一般现在时。

核心结构为：主语 + 动词原形（第三人称单数加 -s/-es）。否定形式在动词前加 do not / does not，疑问形式将 do / does 置于主语前。例如：The earth moves around the sun.（地球绕太阳转。）否定：The earth does not move around the moon. 疑问：Does the earth move around the sun?

与一般过去时的对比：一般过去时表示过去某一时间发生的具体事件或状态，而一般现在时表示不受时间限制的真理。例如：Newton discovered gravity.（过去事件）Gravity pulls objects toward the earth.（普遍真理）。与一般将来时的对比：一般将来时表示将来要发生的事情，而普遍真理不因时间改变，仍用一般现在时。例如：The meeting will start at 9 tomorrow, but the sun rises at 6:05.（会议明天九点开始，但太阳六点零五分升起。）

初中阶段通常只要求识别和运用一般现在时描述日常习惯、简单事实，如“I go to school by bike.”。高中阶段则要求学生在复合句、科普文章、议论文中准确判断：当从句表达客观规律或普遍真理时，即使主句为过去时，从句仍用一般现在时。例如：The teacher told us that light travels faster than sound. 此外，高中还要求区分一般现在时与“be going to / will”在表达预测时的差异：科学事实用一般现在时，主观推测用 will。

易错点：1. 第三人称单数漏加 -s/-es，尤其在长句中主语与动词距离较远时。2. 在宾语从句中，主句为过去时，但从句是客观真理时，仍用一般现在时，不能机械地遵循“主过从过”。3. 混淆一般现在时与现在进行时：普遍真理不用进行时，不能说“The sun is rising in the east.”（除非描述此刻正在发生的具体现象）。4. 时间状语不影响时态选择：即使句中有“yesterday”“tomorrow”等词，只要动词表达的是真理，仍用一般现在时。
forms: 主语 + 动词原形/动词第三人称单数（表示普遍真理）
主语 + do/does + not + 动词原形（否定普遍真理）
Do/Does + 主语 + 动词原形？（询问普遍真理）
主句（一般过去时） + that + 从句（一般现在时，表示客观真理）
There + be + 名词短语（表示客观存在的事实）
It is + 形容词 + that + 从句（一般现在时，表示普遍事实）
notes: 高考书面表达中，描述科学现象、自然规律时，即使整篇文章以过去时为主，真理句仍用一般现在时，否则会被视为时态错误。
在宾语从句中，当主句是过去时，从句若是客观真理，仍用一般现在时，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。
注意区分“习惯性动作”与“正在进行的动作”：普遍真理和习惯用一般现在时，而此刻正在发生的动作用现在进行时。
第三人称单数在科普类书面语中大量出现，漏加 -s/-es 是高中写作中的典型错误，尤其在主语为抽象名词或复杂短语时。
一般现在时表真理时，通常不与“now”“at the moment”等强调此刻的状语连用，除非该状语不影响真理的永恒性。

grammar.key: Passive Voice (Present Continuous) / 被动语态（现在进行时）
grammar.title: 现在进行时的被动语态（am/is/are being done）及其与一般现在时被动、现在完成时被动的辨析
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice (Present Continuous): am/is/are being + past participle
grammar.usage:
现在进行时的被动语态表示“某人或某物此刻正在被……”，强调动作此时此刻正在进行，且主语是动作的承受者。其核心结构为：am/is/are + being + 过去分词。其中 be 动词随主语人称和数变化，being 固定不变，过去分词表示被动含义。

肯定式：主语 + am/is/are + being + 过去分词。例如：The road is being repaired. 否定式在 be 动词后加 not：The road is not being repaired. 疑问式将 be 动词提至主语前：Is the road being repaired? 特殊疑问句则在疑问词后接一般疑问句语序：Where is the road being repaired?

与一般现在时被动语态（am/is/are + done）相比，现在进行时被动多了一个 being，强调动作“正在发生”，而一般现在时被动多表示经常性、习惯性或客观事实。例如：The bridge is repaired every year.（每年都修）与 The bridge is being repaired now.（此刻正在修）含义不同。与现在完成时被动语态（has/have been + done）相比，现在进行时被动强调动作正在进行，而现在完成时被动强调动作已经完成且对现在有影响。例如：The problem is being discussed.（正在讨论）与 The problem has been discussed.（已经讨论过）不可混淆。

初中阶段通常只要求掌握一般现在时、一般过去时和一般将来时的被动语态，而现在进行时的被动语态属于高中阶段的重要拓展。高中阶段还需进一步理解：并非所有动词都可用于进行时被动，短暂性动词（如 hit, kick, close）的进行时被动往往表示动作的重复，而非单一动作的持续。此外，在书面语和正式文体中，现在进行时被动常用来描述正在进行的工程、调查、谈判、改革等，施动者常被省略或用 by 引出。

易错点一：漏掉 being。很多学习者会写成 is repaired 或 is repairing，前者变成一般现在时被动，后者变成主动语态，语义完全不同。易错点二：把 being 写成 been。been 用于完成时被动，being 用于进行时被动，二者不可替换。易错点三：误以为所有动词都有进行时被动。表示状态、所属、感官等的动词（如 have, own, seem, sound）一般不用于进行时被动。易错点四：忽略主谓一致。be 动词的形式必须与主语保持一致，尤其在主语是单数名词或不可数名词时要用 is being，复数名词用 are being，第一人称单数用 am being。
forms: 肯定式：主语 + am/is/are + being + 过去分词
否定式：主语 + am/is/are + not + being + 过去分词
一般疑问式：Am/Is/Are + 主语 + being + 过去分词?
特殊疑问式：疑问词 + am/is/are + 主语 + being + 过去分词?
对比：一般现在时被动 = am/is/are + done；现在进行时被动 = am/is/are + being + done
对比：现在完成时被动 = has/have + been + done；现在进行时被动 = am/is/are + being + done
notes: 进行时被动中 being 不可省略，否则会变成一般现在时被动或主动语态，语义完全不同。
being 与 been 不可混淆：being 用于进行时被动，been 用于完成时被动，高考语法填空常在此设空。
并非所有动词都可用于进行时被动。表示状态、所属、感官等的动词（如 have, own, seem, sound）一般不用于此结构，书面语中尤其要注意。
短暂性动词用于进行时被动时，常表示动作的重复发生，而非单一动作的持续，阅读和写作中需结合语境判断。
在高考书面表达中，使用现在进行时被动可以增强描述的现场感和正式感，但要注意施动者是否必要，避免滥用 by 短语。

grammar.key: Second Conditional (Unreal Present/Future) / 第二条件句（虚拟现在/未来）
grammar.title: 第二条件句（虚拟现在/未来）：if + 过去式，would/could/might + 动词原形
grammar.usage:
第二条件句用于表示与现在事实相反或将来不太可能实现的假设，以及在该假设下可能产生的结果。其核心结构为：if 从句用一般过去时，主句用 would/could/might + 动词原形。例如：If I knew the answer, I would tell you.（如果我知道答案，我会告诉你。）言外之意是“我现在并不知道答案”。

肯定句结构为“If + 主语 + 过去式, 主语 + would/could/might + 动词原形”；否定句可在 if 从句中用 didn't + 动词原形，或在主句中使用 wouldn't/couldn't/mightn't + 动词原形；疑问句通常对主句提问，如“What would you do if you won the lottery?”。if 从句可置于句首或句末，置于句首时常用逗号隔开。

与第一条件句相比，第二条件句的假设性更强、实现可能性更低。第一条件句（If + 一般现在时, will + 动词原形）表示将来很可能发生的情况；第二条件句则用于想象、建议、委婉表达或与现实相反的假设。例如：If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.（第一条件句，明天可能下雨）；If it rained tomorrow, I would stay home.（第二条件句，暗示明天不太可能下雨）。

初中阶段通常只要求掌握第二条件句的基本形式，尤其是“If I were you, I would...”这一固定表达。高中阶段则需要进一步掌握：be 动词在 if 从句中正式语体下统一用 were（即虚拟语气中的 were 型）；主句除 would 外还可使用 could（表示能力或可能性）和 might（表示较低可能性）；if 从句中不能使用 would；以及第二条件句与 wish、as if 等结构的关联。

易错点一：在 if 从句中误用 will/would。第二条件句的 if 从句必须用过去时，不能用 will 或 would。易错点二：主句漏用 would/could/might，直接使用动词原形或一般现在时。易错点三：be 动词在正式书面语中未统一用 were，如误写为“If I was you”。易错点四：将第二条件句与第一条件句混用，无法根据语境判断假设的现实性程度。

notes: 正式书面语和高考语法填空中，if 从句中的 be 动词一律用 were，不受主语人称和数的影响，如 If he were here, he would help us.
if 从句中绝对不能出现 would；would 只能出现在主句中。高考短文改错常将 if 从句中的 would 设为错误点。
主句中使用 could 强调“能够做某事”，might 强调“可能性更小”，would 则表达最直接的推测或意愿。高考阅读中需根据语境区分三者语气强弱。
第二条件句常与 wish（I wish I were...）、as if/as though（He talks as if he knew everything.）等虚拟结构呼应，高中阶段应建立语法体系上的联系。
口语和非正式语体中可能出现 If I was... 或主句用 will 的情况，但高考书面表达和语法题中应使用规范的 were 和 would/could/might 形式。
