exercises.explain: 第二条件句虚拟语气中 be 动词用 were，表示与现在事实相反的假设。

exercises.q: The project would be completed by now if all team members ______ their tasks on time.
exercises.explain: 第二条件句 if 从句用一般过去时，主句用 would be 表示与现在事实相反。

exercises.q: If the company ______ (invest) more in research, it could develop better products.
exercises.explain: 第二条件句 if 从句用一般过去时，invest 的过去式是 invested。

exercises.q: ______ (be) it not for your support, I would have given up long ago.
exercises.explain: Were it not for 是虚拟语气的固定倒装结构，表示"要不是"。

exercises.q: If she ______ (not miss) the flight, she would be attending the conference now.
exercises.explain: 这是混合条件句，if 从句表示过去事实用过去完成时，主句表示现在结果。

exercises.q: If the committee were to approve the proposal, the construction would begin next month.
exercises.explain: If + 主语 + were to do 是第二条件句的正式表达，主句用 would + 动词原形。

exercises.q: If he had listened to my advice, he would not be in trouble now.
exercises.explain: 混合条件句：if 从句用过去完成时表示过去，主句用 would be 表示现在结果。

exercises.q: She didn't take the medicine, so she is still sick now. (用混合条件句改写)
exercises.answer: If she had taken the medicine, she would not be sick now.
exercises.explain: 混合条件句：if 从句用过去完成时表示过去，主句用 would be 表示现在结果。

exercises.q: I am not good at math, so I didn't choose the science major. (用混合条件句改写)
exercises.answer: If I were good at math, I would have chosen the science major.
exercises.explain: 混合条件句：if 从句用过去式表示现在，主句用 would have done 表示过去结果。

exercises.q: He didn't save enough money, so he can't buy the apartment now. (用混合条件句改写)
exercises.answer: If he had saved enough money, he could buy the apartment now.
exercises.explain: 混合条件句：if 从句用过去完成时表示过去，主句用 could 表示现在能力。

exercises.q: If the company would have invested in new technology, it would have stayed competitive.
exercises.answer: If the company had invested in new technology, it would have stayed competitive.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 would have，应用过去完成时 had invested。

exercises.q: Were the government to raise taxes, many small businesses will suffer.
exercises.answer: Were the government to raise taxes, many small businesses would suffer.
exercises.explain: 虚拟条件句主句应用 would + 动词原形，不能用 will。

grammar.key: Comparative Adjectives / 形容词比较级
grammar.title: 形容词比较级：从 -er / than 到 much / far / even / the + 比较级
grammar.titleEn: Comparative Adjectives: -er, than, and Advanced Comparative Structures
grammar.usage:
形容词比较级用于把两个人、事物、情况或时间点进行比较，表示“一方比另一方更……”。最核心的结构是“比较级 + than”，than 后面引出被比较的对象。例如：This box is heavier than that one. 比较级本身由形容词变化而来，单音节形容词通常直接加 -er，多音节形容词则在前面加 more。

肯定句结构为“主语 + 谓语 + 比较级 + than + 比较对象”。否定句在 be 动词或助动词后加 not，例如：This book is not more interesting than that one. 疑问句把 be 动词或助动词提到主语前，例如：Is she taller than her brother? 特殊疑问句则在句首加疑问词，例如：Who is taller, Tom or Jack?

初中阶段主要掌握 -er / more 的基本构成和 than 的基本用法，以及 big→bigger、happy→happier 这类拼写变化。高中阶段则要进一步掌握比较级的修饰语，如 much、far、a lot、even、still、a little、a bit、slightly 等，用来加强或弱化比较程度。例如：The situation is far worse than we expected. 还要掌握“the + 比较级, the + 比较级”结构，表示“越……就越……”，以及“比较级 + and + 比较级”表示“越来越……”。

比较级与 as...as 结构形成对比：as...as 表示“和……一样”，否定形式 not as/so...as 表示“不如……”。例如：This book is as interesting as that one.（一样有趣）This book is not as interesting as that one.（不如那本有趣）。比较级则直接表示程度差异，语气更强。

易错点一：than 后面的人称代词在正式书面语中常用主格，如 taller than I，但口语中常用宾格 than me，高考书面表达建议使用主格或补全谓语，如 than I am。易错点二：不要在同一句中重复使用比较级和 more，例如不能说 more taller。易错点三：部分双音节形容词两种形式都可接受，如 clever→cleverer/more clever，但以 -ful、-less、-ing、-ed 结尾的形容词通常只用 more，如 more useful、more boring。易错点四：比较对象要一致，不能拿事物和人的属性比较，例如不能说 My bag is heavier than you，应说 My bag is heavier than yours。
forms: 单音节形容词：adj. + -er + than，如 tall → taller than
以 -e 结尾的形容词：adj. + -r + than，如 nice → nicer than
辅音字母 + y 结尾：变 y 为 i + -er + than，如 happy → happier than
重读闭音节结尾：双写末尾辅音字母 + -er + than，如 big → bigger than
多音节形容词：more + adj. + than，如 beautiful → more beautiful than
加强/弱化比较：much / far / even / a little / a bit + 比较级 + than
递进比较：比较级 + and + 比较级；the + 比较级, the + 比较级
notes: 高考书面表达中，than 后人称代词建议用主格并补全谓语，如 than I am，避免只写 than me 的语域问题。
much、far、even、still 可以修饰比较级表示“更……得多”，但 very 不能修饰比较级，不能说 very taller。
比较对象要对等：用 that/those 或名词性物主代词代替前面出现过的名词，避免比较对象不一致。
以 -ing、-ed、-ful、-less 结尾的形容词通常用 more 构成比较级，如 more interesting、more useful，而不是加 -er。
“the + 比较级, the + 比较级”结构中，两个分句都要用比较级，且 the 不可省略，如 The harder you work, the better you will be.

examples.en: My schoolbag is heavier than yours.
examples.cn: 我的书包比你的重。

examples.en: Today is much colder than yesterday.
examples.cn: 今天比昨天冷得多。

examples.en: The problem is becoming more and more serious.
examples.cn: 这个问题正变得越来越严重。

examples.en: This solution is far more practical than the previous one.
examples.cn: 这个解决方案比之前的那个实用得多。

examples.en: The more you practice, the more confident you will become.
examples.cn: 你练习得越多，就会变得越自信。

examples.en: The new policy proved slightly more effective than anticipated.
examples.cn: 新政策被证明比预期的略微更有效。

exercises.q: My bag is ______ than yours.
exercises.explain: heavy 以辅音加 y 结尾，变比较级要把 y 改为 i 再加 -er。

exercises.q: Today is ______ than yesterday.
exercises.explain: hot 是单音节词，末尾是单元音加单辅音，需双写 t 再加 -er。

exercises.q: Tom is 12. Jack is 14. Jack is ______ than Tom.
exercises.explain: 两者比较用比较级，old 直接加 -er 变成 older。

exercises.q: This question is ______ than that one.
exercises.explain: easy 以辅音加 y 结尾，变比较级时 y 改为 i 再加 -er。

exercises.q: The blue pen is long. The red pen is ______.
exercises.explain: long 直接加 -er 构成比较级，不需要双写 g。

exercises.q: My sister is two years ______ (young) than me.
exercises.explain: young 直接加 -er 构成比较级。

exercises.q: This box is ______ (big) than that one.
exercises.explain: big 末尾是单元音加单辅音，需双写 g 再加 -er。

exercises.q: The weather is getting ______ (warm) in spring.
exercises.explain: warm 直接加 -er 构成比较级。

exercises.q: The word 'happyer' is the correct comparative form of 'happy'.
exercises.explain: happy 的比较级应把 y 改为 i 再加 -er，即 happier。

exercises.q: We use 'than' to compare two things.
exercises.explain: than 用于引出比较的第二部分，表示两者之间的比较。

exercises.q: This book is thick. That book is thicker. (用 than 合并句子)
exercises.answer: That book is thicker than this book.
exercises.explain: 用 than 连接两个比较对象，形容词用比较级。

exercises.q: My room is small. Your room is smaller. (用 than 改写)
exercises.answer: Your room is smaller than my room.
exercises.explain: 比较两个房间大小时用 smaller than 连接。

exercises.q: Tom is tall. Jack is taller. (用 than 合并句子)
exercises.explain: 两者比较身高，用 taller than 连接。

exercises.q: This apple is more big than that one.
exercises.answer: This apple is bigger than that one.
exercises.explain: big 是单音节形容词，比较级应双写 g 加 -er，不用 more。

exercises.q: She is happyer than her sister.
exercises.answer: She is happier than her sister.
exercises.explain: happy 以辅音加 y 结尾，变比较级时 y 改为 i 再加 -er。

exercises.q: The population of Shanghai is ______ than that of Nanjing.
exercises.explain: large 直接加 -r 构成比较级，表示人口更多。

exercises.q: This film is ______ than the one we saw last week.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词 interesting 的比较级需用 more 构成。

exercises.q: The weather in Hainan is ______ than that in Beijing in winter.
exercises.explain: warm 是单音节形容词，直接加 -er 构成比较级。

exercises.q: My brother is ______ at math than I am.
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是不规则变化 better。

exercises.q: This road is ______ than that one.
exercises.explain: narrow 直接加 -er 构成比较级。

exercises.q: The situation is getting ______ (bad) than before.
exercises.explain: bad 的比较级是不规则变化 worse。

exercises.q: This exercise is ______ (difficult) than the last one.
exercises.explain: difficult 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more 构成。

exercises.q: Her hair is ______ (long) than mine.
exercises.explain: long 直接加 -er 构成比较级。

exercises.q: The comparative form of 'far' can be 'farther' or 'further'.
exercises.explain: far 有两种比较级形式，farther 指距离更远，further 可指程度更进一步。

exercises.q: We say 'more better' to emphasize a comparison.
exercises.explain: better 已经是比较级，不能再加 more，应直接用 better。

exercises.q: This city is not as big as Shanghai. (用 than 改写)
exercises.answer: Shanghai is bigger than this city.
exercises.explain: not as...as 结构可转换为比较级加 than 的句式。

exercises.q: Tom runs fast. Jack runs faster. (用 than 合并)
exercises.explain: fast 的比较级是 faster，用 than 连接两个比较对象。

exercises.q: This book is less interesting than that one. (用 more...than 改写)
exercises.answer: That book is more interesting than this one.
exercises.explain: less...than 可转换为 more...than 的相反表达。

exercises.q: This problem is more easier than that one.
exercises.answer: This problem is easier than that one.
exercises.explain: easier 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: My bag is heavier than you.
exercises.answer: My bag is heavier than yours.
exercises.explain: 比较对象应一致，用名词性物主代词 yours 指代 your bag。

exercises.q: The more you practice, the ______ you will become.
exercises.explain: the more...the better 是固定句型，表示越……越……。

exercises.q: Storms are becoming ______ than ever before.
exercises.explain: strong 是单音节形容词，比较级直接加 -er。

exercises.q: The ______ you study, the higher marks you will get.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 表示越……越……。

exercises.q: This is ______ than any other book I have read.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词比较级用 more 构成，than 提示用比较级。

exercises.q: The number of cars in the city is much ______ than it was ten years ago.
exercises.explain: much 可修饰比较级，large 直接加 -r 构成 larger。

exercises.q: The ______ (careful) you are, the fewer mistakes you will make.
exercises.explain: careful 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more 构成。

exercises.q: His health is getting ______ (good) than before.
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是不规则变化 better。

exercises.q: The situation is far ______ (serious) than we expected.
exercises.explain: serious 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more 构成，far 修饰比较级。

exercises.q: In the sentence 'The harder you work, the luckier you get', both 'harder' and 'luckier' are comparative forms.
exercises.explain: harder 和 luckier 都是比较级，用于 the more...the more 句型。

exercises.q: The phrase 'much more stronger' is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: stronger 已经是比较级，不能再加 more，应说 much stronger。

exercises.q: No other student in the class is as tall as Tom. (用比较级改写)
exercises.answer: Tom is taller than any other student in the class.
exercises.explain: 用比较级加 any other 表达最高级含义。

exercises.q: The weather is becoming increasingly cold. (用比较级改写)
exercises.answer: The weather is becoming colder and colder.
exercises.explain: 比较级重复使用可表示越来越……。

exercises.q: If you read more books, you will know more. (用 the more...the more 改写)
exercises.answer: The more books you read, the more you will know.
exercises.explain: the more...the more 句型表示越……越……。

exercises.q: The more he eats, the fatter he gets, and the more unhealthy he becomes.
exercises.answer: The more he eats, the fatter he gets, and the unhealthier he becomes.
exercises.explain: unhealthy 以辅音加 y 结尾，比较级应把 y 改为 i 再加 -er。

exercises.q: This is the most cheapest phone in the store.
exercises.answer: This is the cheapest phone in the store.
exercises.explain: cheapest 已经是最高级，不能再加 most。

exercises.q: My brother is two years ______ than me.
exercises.explain: 单音节形容词 old 的比较级是 older，且句中有 than。

exercises.q: This box is ______ than that one.
exercises.explain: 以 y 结尾的 heavy 变比较级时要把 y 改为 i 再加 er。

exercises.q: Today is ______ than yesterday.
exercises.explain: hot 是重读闭音节，末尾辅音字母 t 要双写再加 er。

exercises.q: The blue bag is ______ than the red one.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词 expensive 的比较级用 more 构成。

exercises.q: Her hair is ______ than mine.
exercises.explain: 单音节形容词 long 直接加 er 构成比较级。

exercises.q: The weather is getting ______ (cold) and ______ (cold).
exercises.explain: 比较级连用表示“越来越……”，cold 直接加 er。

exercises.q: This story is ______ (interesting) than that one.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词 interesting 的比较级用 more 构成。

exercises.q: My schoolbag is ______ (big) than yours.
exercises.explain: big 是重读闭音节，双写 g 再加 er。

exercises.q: The sentence "She is more taller than her sister." is correct.
exercises.explain: taller 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: The sentence "This river is wider than that one." is correct.
exercises.explain: wide 以 e 结尾，直接加 r 构成 wider，用法正确。

exercises.q: Tom is tall. Jack is taller. (用 than 合并句子)
exercises.explain: 用比较级 taller 加 than 连接两个比较对象。

exercises.q: This book is interesting. That book is more interesting. (用 than 合并句子)
exercises.answer: That book is more interesting than this book.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词 interesting 用 more 构成比较级，再用 than 连接。

exercises.q: The cat is small. The dog is smaller. (改为否定比较句)
exercises.answer: The cat is not smaller than the dog.
exercises.explain: 在 is 后加 not 构成否定比较句。

exercises.q: My bag is more heavy than your bag.
exercises.answer: My bag is heavier than your bag.
exercises.explain: heavy 的比较级是 heavier，不用 more heavy。

exercises.q: This apple is biger than that one.
exercises.answer: This apple is bigger than that one.
exercises.explain: big 是重读闭音节，比较级要双写 g 再加 er。

exercises.q: The situation is getting ______ than we expected.
exercises.explain: bad 的比较级是不规则变化 worse。

exercises.q: She speaks English ______ than her classmates.
exercises.explain: 修饰动词 speaks 要用副词比较级，fluently 是多音节副词，用 more 构成比较级。

exercises.q: The ______ you work, the ______ results you will get.
exercises.explain: “the+比较级, the+比较级”表示“越……越……”，hard 和 good 的比较级分别是 harder 和 better。

exercises.q: This problem is ______ than the one we solved last week.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词 difficult 可用 less 构成降级比较，表示“不如……难”。

exercises.q: Among all the students, Lucy runs ______.
exercises.explain: among all 表示三者以上范围，用最高级 fastest。

exercises.q: The new model is ______ (good) than the old one, but it is also ______ (expensive).
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是不规则变化 better；expensive 是多音节形容词，用 more 构成比较级。

exercises.q: He felt ______ (tired) after the long journey than he had expected.
exercises.explain: tired 是双音节形容词，通常用 more 构成比较级。

exercises.q: The ______ (careful) you are, the ______ (few) mistakes you will make.
exercises.explain: “the+比较级, the+比较级”结构，careful 用 more careful，few 的比较级是 fewer。

exercises.q: The sentence "This is the most cheapest restaurant in town." is correct.
exercises.explain: cheapest 已经是最高级，不能再加 most。

exercises.q: The sentence "Her health is getting better and better." is correct.
exercises.explain: 比较级连用表示“越来越……”，better and better 用法正确。

exercises.q: This task is not as difficult as that one. (用 than 改写，保持句意)
exercises.answer: That task is more difficult than this one.
exercises.explain: not as...as 表示“不如”，改写时用比较级 more difficult 加 than 表达相同意思。

exercises.q: No other student in the class is as tall as Mike. (用最高级改写)
exercises.answer: Mike is the tallest student in the class.
exercises.explain: “没有其他人像……一样”可转换为最高级表达。

exercises.q: The movie was less interesting than the book. (用 not as...as 改写)
exercises.answer: The movie was not as interesting as the book.
exercises.explain: less...than 与 not as...as 可互换表达相同比较含义。

exercises.q: This road is more wider than the one near my house.
exercises.answer: This road is wider than the one near my house.
exercises.explain: wider 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: The weather in the south is warmer than the north.
exercises.answer: The weather in the south is warmer than that in the north.
exercises.explain: 比较对象要一致，用 that 指代 the weather，避免拿天气和北方比较。

exercises.q: The more you practice, ______ you will become.
exercises.explain: “the+比较级, the+比较级”结构，confident 是多音节形容词，用 more 构成比较级。

exercises.q: Storms are becoming stronger than ever before, ______ makes coastal residents increasingly worried.
exercises.explain: which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面整个主句的内容。

exercises.q: The gap between the rich and the poor is ______ than it was a decade ago.
exercises.explain: far 可修饰比较级加强语气，wide 的比较级是 wider。

exercises.q: Of the two proposals, the second one is ______.
exercises.explain: 两者比较用比较级，且特指两者中较……的一个时加 the。

exercises.q: He is ______ than his brother, but he is not ______ in the family.
exercises.explain: diligent 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more，最高级用 the most。

exercises.q: The ______ (far) we walked into the forest, the ______ (dark) it became.
exercises.explain: “the+比较级, the+比较级”结构，far 的比较级可用 farther 或 further，dark 直接加 er。

exercises.q: Her performance in the final exam was ______ (good) than expected, but still not ______ (good) in the class.
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是 better，最高级是 the best。

exercises.q: The new policy is ______ (little) effective than the government claimed.
exercises.explain: little 的比较级是 less，表示“不如……有效”。

exercises.q: The sentence "The more knowledge you acquire, the more you realize how little you know." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: “the+比较级, the+比较级”结构使用正确，表达“越……越……”。

exercises.q: The sentence "This is the most unique opportunity I have ever had." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: unique 本身表示“独一无二的”，通常不用比较级或最高级。

exercises.q: The situation is becoming increasingly serious. (用比较级改写，保持句意)
exercises.answer: The situation is becoming more and more serious.
exercises.explain: increasingly 可转换为比较级连用 more and more serious 表达“越来越严重”。

exercises.q: He is the most talented player on the team. (用比较级改写，保持句意)
exercises.answer: He is more talented than any other player on the team.
exercises.explain: 最高级可转换为“比较级+than any other”结构表达相同含义。

exercises.q: I have never seen a more beautiful sunset than this one. (用最高级改写)
exercises.answer: This is the most beautiful sunset I have ever seen.
exercises.explain: 否定词+比较级可转换为最高级表达。

exercises.q: The more harder you try, the more likely you are to succeed.
exercises.answer: The harder you try, the more likely you are to succeed.
exercises.explain: harder 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: Compared with his earlier works, this novel is more better structured and more deeply moving.
exercises.answer: Compared with his earlier works, this novel is better structured and more deeply moving.
exercises.explain: better 已经是 good 的比较级，不能再加 more。

grammar.key: Modal Verbs for Prediction & Certainty (will, would) / 情态动词表示预测和确定性（will, would）
grammar.title: 情态动词表示预测与确定性：will / would / be able to / may / might
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verbs for Prediction & Certainty: will, would, be able to, may, might
grammar.usage:
本语法点围绕情态动词表达“预测”和“确定性”展开，核心结构为“情态动词 + 动词原形”。其中 will 表示对未来事件或结果的强烈预测，语气较为确定；won't（will not）表示对未来情况的否定预测。would 则用于假设情境、委婉表达或过去时间框架中的预测，语气比 will 更弱、更不肯定。be able to 常与 will / would 连用，构成 will be able to / would be able to，表示“将来/假设条件下能够做某事”，强调能力而非单纯意愿。may 和 might 也可表示对未来的预测，但确定性依次递减：will > may > might > would（假设语境中）。

肯定句结构为“主语 + will/would/may/might + 动词原形”，否定句在情态动词后加 not，如 will not (won't)、would not (wouldn't)、may not、might not。疑问句将情态动词提至主语前，如 Will you be able to finish it? 回答时通常保留情态动词，如 Yes, I will. / No, I won't.

与近义结构对比：will 与 be going to 都可表预测，但 will 更侧重说话人当下的判断或承诺，be going to 更侧重已有迹象或计划；would 与 used to 都可表过去，但 would 多用于过去习惯性动作或假设结果，used to 强调过去状态与现在的对比；may/might 与 could 都可表可能性，但 could 更常用于能力或委婉请求，may/might 更侧重“可能发生”的推测。

初中阶段主要掌握 will 表示将来预测、won't 表示否定预测，以及 will be able to 的基本用法。高中阶段需进一步掌握 would 在虚拟条件句和委婉表达中的用法，理解 will/would/may/might 在确定性上的梯度差异，并能在书面表达中根据语境选择恰当的情态动词，避免一味使用 will。

易错点：一是将 will 与 be going to 混用，忽略语境中“已有迹象”与“当下判断”的区别；二是在条件状语从句中误用 will，如 If it will rain 应为 If it rains；三是将 would 仅理解为 will 的过去式，忽视其在假设和委婉语境中的独立功能；四是在书面表达中过度使用 will，导致语气过于绝对，缺乏对 may/might/could 等委婉表达的运用。
forms: 主语 + will + 动词原形（肯定预测）
主语 + won't/will not + 动词原形（否定预测）
主语 + will/would + be able to + 动词原形（未来/假设能力）
主语 + may/might + 动词原形（可能性预测，确定性递减）
Will/Would/May/Might + 主语 + 动词原形？（疑问句）
If + 主语 + 一般现在时，主语 + will/would + 动词原形（条件句中的预测）
notes: 高考书面表达中，避免通篇使用 will 表达预测，适当穿插 may、might、could 以体现语气层次和语言丰富度。
would 在虚拟条件句（If I were you, I would...）中不可替换为 will，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。
will be able to 强调“将来有能力做到”，与 can 不同，can 通常不用于将来时，需用 will be able to 替代。
在正式书面语中，will not 比 won't 更正式；但在口语和记叙文中，won't 更自然。注意语域选择。
may not 表示“可能不”，而 cannot 表示“不可能”，两者确定性不同，高考阅读中常据此设置推断题。

examples.en: It will rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
examples.cn: 明天会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

examples.en: She won't pass the exam if she doesn't study harder.
examples.cn: 如果她不用功学习，她就不会通过考试。

examples.en: Without bees, we won't be able to enjoy chocolate and strawberries as much as we do now.
examples.cn: 没有蜜蜂，我们将无法像现在这样尽情享用巧克力和草莓。

examples.en: If I had more time, I would learn a third language.
examples.cn: 如果我有更多时间，我会学第三门语言。

examples.en: The new policy may reduce pollution, but it might also slow down economic growth.
examples.cn: 新政策可能会减少污染，但也可能减缓经济增长。

examples.en: Had the warning been issued earlier, the damage would have been far less severe.
examples.cn: 如果警告更早发布，损失本会轻得多。

exercises.q: Don't worry. I ______ you with your homework tomorrow.
exercises.explain: tomorrow 提示将来，用 will + 动词原形表示预测或承诺。

exercises.q: Look at those dark clouds. It ______ rain soon.
exercises.explain: 根据迹象预测即将下雨，用 will 表示对未来的判断。

exercises.q: Without water, plants ______ grow.
exercises.explain: won't = will not，后接动词原形 grow，表示未来确定不会发生。

exercises.q: I think she ______ pass the exam. She studied very hard.
exercises.explain: 根据她努力学习的迹象，用 will 表示对未来的肯定预测。

exercises.q: He is ill, so he ______ come to school tomorrow.
exercises.explain: 生病导致明天不能来，用 won't 表示对未来的否定预测。

exercises.q: I am busy now, but I ______ finish the work tonight.
exercises.explain: tonight 提示将来，用 will 表示说话人的打算或预测。

exercises.q: Without the sun, there ______ be no life on Earth.
exercises.explain: without 引导假设条件，用 will 表示确定的结果。

exercises.q: Don't stay up too late, or you ______ feel tired tomorrow.
exercises.explain: or 表示否则，后面用 will 预测不好的结果。

exercises.q: The sentence "She will comes tomorrow." is correct.
exercises.explain: will 后必须接动词原形，comes 应改为 come。

exercises.q: "Won't" is the short form of "will not".
exercises.explain: won't 是 will not 的缩写形式。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: I will go to the park tomorrow.
exercises.answer: I won't go to the park tomorrow.
exercises.explain: will 的否定形式是 won't，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in question form: You will help me.
exercises.explain: 一般将来时疑问句把 will 提到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "won't be able to": She can't come to the party.
exercises.answer: She won't be able to come to the party.
exercises.explain: won't be able to 表示将来不能做某事。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: He will goes to school by bike tomorrow.
exercises.answer: He will go to school by bike tomorrow.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形，goes 应改为 go。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: Without bees, we won't able to enjoy chocolate.
exercises.answer: Without bees, we won't be able to enjoy chocolate.
exercises.explain: won't 后需要 be able to，缺少 be 动词。

exercises.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ______ stay at home.
exercises.explain: if 引导真实条件句，主句用 will 表示将来可能发生的结果。

exercises.q: I'm not sure if he ______ come to the meeting.
exercises.explain: if 表示是否，从句用 will 表示将来的可能性。

exercises.q: She said she ______ call me later, but she didn't.
exercises.explain: 主句是过去时 said，从句用 would 表示过去将来。

exercises.q: Without your help, I ______ be able to finish the work on time.
exercises.explain: without 表示与事实相反的假设，用 would 表示虚拟结果。

exercises.q: Don't worry. You ______ be able to solve the problem if you try.
exercises.explain: if you try 是真实条件，主句用 will be able to 表示将来的能力。

exercises.q: He promised that he ______ help me with my English.
exercises.explain: 主句 promised 是过去时，从句用 would 表示过去将来。

exercises.q: If we don't protect the environment, many animals ______ disappear.
exercises.explain: if 条件句表示真实假设，主句用 will 预测结果。

exercises.q: I knew that she ______ be late because of the traffic.
exercises.explain: knew 是过去时，从句用 would 表示过去的预测。

exercises.q: In the sentence "He said he will come", the verb tense is correct.
exercises.explain: 主句 said 是过去时，从句应用 would 而非 will。

exercises.q: "Would" can be used to talk about a hypothetical situation.
exercises.explain: would 常用于假设或不太确定的情况。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "would": She said, "I will help you."
exercises.answer: She said that she would help me.
exercises.explain: 直接引语转间接引语，will 要变为 would。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: He would like to go with us.
exercises.answer: He wouldn't like to go with us.
exercises.explain: would 的否定形式是 wouldn't。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "will be able to": She can speak English well after practice.
exercises.answer: She will be able to speak English well after practice.
exercises.explain: will be able to 表示将来具备某种能力。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: If I were you, I will apologize to him.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I would apologize to him.
exercises.explain: 虚拟语气中，if I were you 主句用 would 而非 will。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: He said he will be able to come tomorrow.
exercises.answer: He said he would be able to come tomorrow.
exercises.explain: 主句 said 是过去时，从句 will 应改为 would。

exercises.q: By the time you arrive, the meeting ______ already have started.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导时间状语，主句用 will have done 表示将来完成。

exercises.q: If we had taken the earlier train, we ______ have arrived on time.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句，主句用 would have done。

exercises.q: The scientist predicted that the ice caps ______ melt faster in the coming decades.
exercises.explain: 主句 predicted 是过去时，从句用 would 表示过去预测。

exercises.q: Without the bees' pollination, many crops ______ fail to produce fruit.
exercises.explain: without 表示与事实相反的假设，用 would 表示虚拟结果。

exercises.q: I ______ be grateful if you could give me a second chance.
exercises.explain: if you could 是委婉假设，主句用 would 表示礼貌请求。

exercises.q: If the government had acted earlier, the crisis ______ have been avoided.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟语气，主句用 would have done。

exercises.q: The report warned that sea levels ______ rise significantly by 2100.
exercises.explain: warned 是过去时，从句用 would 表示过去的预测。

exercises.q: Given the current trend, the company ______ probably expand its market next year.
exercises.explain: given 表示根据现状，用 will 表示对未来的合理预测。

exercises.q: In the sentence "If he had studied harder, he would pass the exam", the grammar is correct.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟语气，主句应为 would have passed。

exercises.q: "Will have done" is used to talk about an action that will be completed before a certain future time.
exercises.explain: 将来完成时表示在将来某一时间之前完成的动作。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "would have": She didn't come, so she didn't meet him.
exercises.answer: If she had come, she would have met him.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句，用 would have done 表示假设结果。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "will have": By next month, I will finish the project.
exercises.answer: By next month, I will have finished the project.
exercises.explain: by next month 提示将来完成时，用 will have done。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "would be able to": If he practiced more, he could win the competition.
exercises.answer: If he practiced more, he would be able to win the competition.
exercises.explain: would be able to 表示在假设条件下具备的能力。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: If she had known the truth, she will not have trusted him.
exercises.answer: If she had known the truth, she would not have trusted him.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟语气，主句用 would not have done。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: The forecast said it will rain tomorrow, but it didn't.
exercises.answer: The forecast said it would rain tomorrow, but it didn't.
exercises.explain: 主句 said 是过去时，从句 will 应改为 would 表示过去预测。

exercises.q: Don't worry. I'm sure you ______ the exam if you keep practicing.
exercises.explain: 对未来的确定预测用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: If we don't protect the forest, many animals ______ their homes.
exercises.explain: 条件句表示未来可能的结果时，主句用 will。

exercises.q: Without water, plants ______ able to grow.
exercises.explain: won't be able to 表示未来将无法做某事。

exercises.q: I think it ______ sunny tomorrow, so we can go hiking.
exercises.explain: 对明天天气的预测用 will be。

exercises.q: If you eat too much candy, you ______ a stomachache.
exercises.explain: 条件句主句表示将来可能的结果，用 will get。

exercises.q: If we leave now, we ______ arrive before dark.
exercises.explain: 条件句主句用 will 表示对未来的预测。

exercises.q: Without bees, we ______ be able to enjoy many fruits.
exercises.explain: won't 是 will not 的缩写，表示未来不能。

exercises.q: She studies very hard, so she ______ pass the test easily.
exercises.explain: 根据现有迹象做出的确定预测用 will。

exercises.q: The sentence "He will comes tomorrow" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: will 后必须接动词原形，不能接 comes。

exercises.q: In the sentence "We won't be able to finish the work without help", "won't" expresses a future prediction.
exercises.explain: won't 在此表示对未来情况的确定预测。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: The train will arrive on time.
exercises.answer: The train won't arrive on time.
exercises.explain: will 的否定形式是 won't，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a question: You will help me with the project.
exercises.answer: Will you help me with the project?
exercises.explain: 一般将来时的疑问句将 will 提到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "be able to": She will finish the task alone.
exercises.answer: She will be able to finish the task alone.
exercises.explain: will be able to 表示将来有能力做某事。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: They will not able to come to the party.
exercises.answer: They will not be able to come to the party.
exercises.explain: will not 后需要接 be able to，不能省略 be。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: If it rains, we would stay at home.
exercises.answer: If it rains, we will stay at home.
exercises.explain: 真实条件句表示将来可能发生的情况，主句用 will。

exercises.q: If I had more time, I ______ learn to play the guitar.
exercises.explain: 与现在事实相反的假设用 would。

exercises.q: The scientist predicted that the sea level ______ rise by 20 centimeters by 2050.
exercises.explain: 过去时态中的预测用 would，表示过去将来。

exercises.q: Without the sun, there ______ be no life on Earth.
exercises.explain: 与现在事实相反的假设情况用 would。

exercises.q: I'm not sure, but I think she ______ probably accept the offer.
exercises.explain: 对未来较有把握的预测用 will，probably 是提示词。

exercises.q: He said he ______ call me when he arrived.
exercises.explain: 间接引语中过去将来用 would。

exercises.q: If we had taken the earlier train, we ______ have arrived by now.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的假设用 would have done。

exercises.q: The weather report says it ______ rain later this evening.
exercises.explain: 天气预报的预测用 will。

exercises.q: She promised that she ______ help me with my homework.
exercises.explain: 过去时态中的承诺用 would。

exercises.q: The sentence "If I were you, I will apologize" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: 虚拟语气中与现在事实相反，主句应用 would。

exercises.q: "Would" can be used to make a prediction about a hypothetical situation.
exercises.explain: would 常用于假设情况下的预测。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "would": I think it is possible that he will come to the meeting.
exercises.answer: I think he would come to the meeting.
exercises.explain: 用 would 表达不太确定的推测。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "be able to": She will solve the problem without any help.
exercises.answer: She will be able to solve the problem without any help.
exercises.explain: will be able to 表示将来有能力做某事。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a negative statement: He said he would arrive before noon.
exercises.answer: He said he wouldn't arrive before noon.
exercises.explain: would 的否定形式是 wouldn't。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: If I know the answer, I would tell you.
exercises.answer: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
exercises.explain: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句，从句用过去式 knew。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: She will can finish the project by Friday.
exercises.answer: She will be able to finish the project by Friday.
exercises.explain: will 后不能直接接 can，应用 will be able to。

exercises.q: Had the government acted earlier, the economic crisis ______ have been avoided.
exercises.explain: 省略 if 的虚拟条件句，主句用 would have done。

exercises.q: The researchers concluded that without intervention, the species ______ become extinct within a decade.
exercises.explain: 过去时态中的预测用 would，表示过去将来。

exercises.q: Given the current trend, it is almost certain that the population ______ exceed nine billion by 2050.
exercises.explain: almost certain 表示高度确定的预测，用 will。

exercises.q: If the experiment had been conducted under controlled conditions, the results ______ have been more reliable.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的假设，主句用 would have done。

exercises.q: The committee announced that the new policy ______ take effect the following month.
exercises.explain: 过去时态中的将来用 would。

exercises.q: But for the timely rescue, the climbers ______ not have survived the avalanche.
exercises.explain: but for 引导的虚拟条件，主句用 would have done。

exercises.q: The model predicts that global temperatures ______ continue to rise unless emissions are reduced.
exercises.explain: 科学模型的预测用 will 表示确定性。

exercises.q: She was convinced that her proposal ______ be accepted without any major revisions.
exercises.explain: 过去时态中的预测用 would。

exercises.q: In the sentence "Had he known the risks, he would not have invested", "would" expresses a hypothetical past result.
exercises.explain: would have done 表示与过去事实相反的假设结果。

exercises.q: The sentence "Without the discovery of penicillin, modern medicine will be very different" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: 与现在事实相反的假设应用 would be，而非 will be。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "would have": If the warning had been issued earlier, many lives could be saved.
exercises.answer: If the warning had been issued earlier, many lives would have been saved.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的假设，主句用 would have been done。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "be able to" in future tense: The team can complete the project by the deadline.
exercises.answer: The team will be able to complete the project by the deadline.
exercises.explain: will be able to 表示将来有能力完成。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a hypothetical statement: Without your support, the event is a failure.
exercises.answer: Without your support, the event would be a failure.
exercises.explain: 与现在事实相反的假设用 would be。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: If the data had been analyzed more carefully, the researchers will have noticed the anomaly.
exercises.answer: If the data had been analyzed more carefully, the researchers would have noticed the anomaly.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的假设，主句应用 would have done。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The forecast predicted that the hurricane would to hit the coast by midnight.
exercises.answer: The forecast predicted that the hurricane would hit the coast by midnight.
exercises.explain: would 后接动词原形，不能加 to。
